content: The position of the centre of mass of a uniform semi-circular wire of radius 'R' placed in x-y plane with its centre at the origin and the line joining its ends as x-axis is given by <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.798ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="7.334ex" height="2.782ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -877 3241.8 1229.7" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mrow"><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(0 -0.5)"><use data-c="28" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-SO-28"></use></g><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD" transform="translate(458,0)"><g data-mml-node="mn"><use data-c="30" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-30"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(500,0)"><use data-c="2C" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-2C"></use></g><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD" transform="translate(944.7,0)"><g data-mml-node="mfrac"><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" transform="translate(220,394) scale(0.707)" data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D465" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D465"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(572,0)"><use data-c="1D445" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D445"></use></g></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(488,-345) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="1D70B" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D70B"></use></g><rect width="1141.2" height="60" x="120" y="220"></rect></g></g></g><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(2783.8,0) translate(0 -0.5)"><use data-c="29" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-SO-29"></use></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>. Then, the value of | x | is ______________.
explanation:
Centre of mass of half ring is located at a distance from centre of the ring on its axis of symmetry so position of centre of mass in the given question will be

| x | = 2
